name: Odo
description: Odo – the little owl with big ideas – helps make the Forest Camp for Young Birds lots of fun!

videos.title: The Egg
videos.overview: Odo’s Mum and Dad drop Odo off at Forest Camp where he learns one of the most important lessons for a bird—caring for an egg.

videos.title: Club Chicken
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle meet jolly chickens Jo, Flo and Shirley, who tell the pair that they always have fun in Club Chicken – the silliest club in the forest.

videos.title: The Inspector
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle pretend to be 'Inspector Oodle' in The Inspector. Odo and Doodle even award the camp a Golden Acorn trophy.

videos.title: Doodle Song
videos.overview: Every bird has their own song-except Doodle doesn't know what a 'Doodle Song' is supposed to sound like. Odo tries everything he can think of to help Doodle.

videos.title: Reggie
videos.overview: Odo brings the best show and tell to forest camp - a fox named Reggie. Reggie is a great show and tell, but the birds find him terrifying. Odo tries to convince the campers that Reggie the Veggie is friendly.

videos.title: Forest Camp: The Film!
videos.overview: The birds make their own movie about life at Forest Camp. With Odo operating the camera, it doesn't come out perfect, but the movie shows that Forest Camp is a place where everybody does their best and has fun.

videos.title: Fowl Play
videos.overview: Odo isn't chosen for the camp football team because he's 'too little.' So Odo and the little birds challenge the big birds to a football match.

videos.title: The Deputy
videos.overview: A Deputy Camp Leader has to be someone who is fast, fair and very, very helpful. Odo is sure he can be all those things, but doesn't know if he can beat the bigger birds.

videos.title: Spoooooky!
videos.overview: First, the campers find Odo cute and funny, but Odo wants to be spooky, so with the help of a timid mouse, he plays a trick on the campers that they'll never forget.

videos.title: The Kite
videos.overview: It's a windy day and Odo wants to fly his kite, but Camp Leader has planned feather crafts instead, but when an intruder comes to camp, it's up to Odo and Doodle to save the day.

videos.title: Doodling Doodle
videos.overview: The campers are painting a portrait of their best friend. Odo is Doodle’s best friend, so of course Odo should be the best at painting her portrait.

videos.title: Fear of Flying
videos.overview: Odo tries everything he can think of to help Doodle get over her fear of flying. However, he learns that when a friend has a problem, sometimes the best thing you can do is listen.

videos.title: Moon Cheese
videos.overview: Odo says he can go to the moon but then lands in hot water after everything he and Doodle try comes up short, until Odo's dad shows up to help.

videos.title: Pond Life
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle learn about how things grow after finding tiny creatures in the pond.

videos.title: The Biscuit Pincher
videos.overview: Odo is accused of pinching one of Camp Leader's biscuits - but owls are honest birds!

videos.title: Sleepover
videos.overview: Odo's sleepover is great fun with snacks and spooky stories and knocking at the door.

videos.title: Tall Tails
videos.overview: The Elite Jungle Adventure Challenge is the most fun obstacle course in the forest.

videos.title: Super Owl!
videos.overview: Odo spends the day wearing a cape and rescuing those in need after reading a comic book.

videos.title: Stuck in a Hut
videos.overview: Odo follows Scuttle, his beetle pal and accidentally gets locked in Camp Leader's hut with Rosie and Flo. Odo keeps their spirits up using a ping pong ball and a tin of peaches.

videos.title: Odd Couple
videos.overview: Odo has been paired with Leonardo to make a sculpture of their 'favourite thing about camp'. Odo discovers that you can learn surprising things from new friends.

videos.title: Lost Pet
videos.overview: Odo is thrilled to spend the day looking after Eaglet's pet snail, Freddy. Odo has always wanted a pet and if he can prove he's a good snail-carer, maybe he can have his own pet.

videos.title: Bad Apple
videos.overview: It’s time for the yearly Apple Festival, but everything is going wrong and Reggie the fox gets the blame in Bad Apple. Will Odo be able to prove that his furry friend is innocent?

videos.title: Comedy of Errors
videos.overview: The toucans love joking and making people laugh, but when they accidentally injure Doodle, they ask Odo to teach them how to be sensible.

videos.title: Special Delivery
videos.overview: Odo accidentally gets a postcard with a picture of a tropical island and decides he wants to go to the south, where it's warm and lovely. He tries posting himself to 'the south.'

videos.title: The Wise Guys
videos.overview: Odo is really surprised when Bud and Louie turn out to be geniuses at leaf spotting, and he wants to become a genius just like them.

videos.title: Bird Statues
videos.overview: Shirley the Chicken is unbeatable at Bird Statues until she comes up against a little owl named Odo.

videos.title: Job Day
videos.overview: Odo comes up with tons of new business ideas for the camp's "jobs day," but none seem to work out until he starts thinking about what others need.

videos.title: Flower Power
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle volunteer to spend the day protecting a delicate plant. With the help of their friends Reggie the Fox and Michael the Mouse, they keep their leafy friend safe.

videos.title: Hoot and Mummy
videos.overview: After inviting his parents to 'Bring Your Parents to Camp Day' on the wrong day, Odo hopes to make the most of his mistake by showing his friends just how fun his parents can be.

videos.title: Falling Stars
videos.overview: While camping out in the woods at night to watch the falling stars, Odo and Doodle hope to have a memorable night, but when Doodle gets lost in the dark, Odo must save the day.

videos.title: Bad Luck
videos.overview: Odo has missed out on snacks, his boat has broken, and his new hat has fallen apart- today is nothing but Bad Luck. Doodle suggests a four-leaf clover will give Odo good luck.

videos.title: Feather's Feather
videos.overview: Odo just needs one more feather to complete his collection, a feather from a Golden Eagle. But the only Golden Eagle he knows is Inspector Feathers.

videos.title: Yes and No
videos.overview: Doodle doesn't like to let anybody down, so she says 'yes' to everyone in Yes and No. But this means she misses her favourite song on the radio. Odo teaches Doodle how to say 'no'.

videos.title: Lord of the Flyers
videos.overview: Odo has convinced Camp Leader to leave Pigeon Post in charge of the camp for the day. Now the campers are out of control! The birds are covered in paint, whooping and dancing.

videos.title: Seedcake Surprise
videos.overview: When Odo and Doodle eat the seed cake that Dad was going to give to Mum as an anniversary surprise, it's up to Odo to keep Mum busy while Dad bakes a new Seedcake Surprise.

videos.title: Time Capsule
videos.overview: Camp Leader shows the campers a time capsule. Now Odo wants to bury something that will show birds of the future what Forest Camp is like for him and his friends.

videos.title: Bye Bye Scuttle
videos.overview: Odo's beetle pal, Scuttle, dies and Odo doesn't know what to feel. One minute he's angry, the next minute he wants to play, and then he wants to be left alone.

videos.title: Martin
videos.overview: When a migratory bird named Martin is accidentally separated from his flock, Odo and Doodle make him feel at home in forest camp. The campers are unsure about this strange new bird.

videos.title: After the Storm
videos.overview: One of Odo's favourite trees has fallen down. But it's worse for Michael the mouse-his whole home has been swept away, and Odo promises to help him.

videos.title: Plastic Peril
videos.overview: Odo finds a plastic bottle in Plastic Peril. He tries to throw it away, but the bottle causes problems for the campers. Then, Odo finds a good use for a thrown away item.

videos.title: Express Yourself
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle set up a messenger service, but the messages get muddled and they can't figure out why.

videos.title: The Big Nest
videos.overview: Odo has a new dance move but no-one notices it. He tricks the other birds into building him the biggest nest at the top of the tallest in the forest as a stage.

videos.title: Rumours
videos.overview: Odo hears a rumour about Camp Leader leaving, he hatches a wild scheme to get her to stay.

videos.title: Worry
videos.overview: Leonardo's mum is at the doctor today, and he is very worried about her in Worry?

videos.title: Ger
videos.overview: Odo meets Michael's brother, Ger, but gets a surprise because Ger doesn't like Odo at all.

videos.title: Fancy Lunch Fiasco
videos.overview: Camp Leader has important business to discuss with Inspector Feathers about Forest Camp.

videos.title: Memory Lane
videos.overview: Camp Leader remembers old adventures while Odo has new adventures of his own.

videos.title: Superbird
videos.overview: The Superbird Challenge is a big, camp-wide competition with some surprising winners.

videos.title: Purple Pack
videos.overview: Odo gives all of the birds a new look that starts to create some problems.

videos.title: Pink
videos.overview: Forest Day is a celebration in honour of the forest, but the birds don't want to clean up.

videos.title: Bird Watching
videos.overview: Odo discovers that he has amazing 'owl vision,' which lets Odo see faraway things.

videos.title: Mum
videos.overview: Odo has never met Doodle's Mum, in fact he's never been invited to Doodle's home at all.

videos.title: The Secret Knock
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle build a den and come up with a secret knock to gain entrance. However, when Odo goes out, he's distracted by rhythmic activities in camp and forgets the secret code.

videos.title: The Piano Lesson
videos.overview: Odo takes his first piano lesson with Doodle's mum and it goes disastrously wrong.

videos.title: Cuckoo!
videos.overview: When Odo and Doodle break Camp Leader's new cuckoo clock they pretend to fix it.

videos.title: Thelma's Song
videos.overview: Odo needs to make rain so that Thelma can be the first bird to sing when the rain stops.

videos.title: Martin Returns
videos.overview: Martin, the migratory bird, returns to camp as a refugee after his home is destroyed.

videos.title: Best Joke Ever
videos.overview: The chickens argue over who came up with a joke, and Odo has to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Funny Doodle
videos.overview: Doodle asks Odo to teach her how to be funny.

videos.title: Once upon a Camp Leader
videos.overview: Odo encourages Camp Leader to pursue her dream of being an author.

videos.title: Friends Day
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle teach John John how to make friends by 'being yourself'.

videos.title: Monster! Monster!
videos.overview: Doodle is frightened by the sound of a falling pinecone.

videos.title: Martin's Wonderland
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle try to rebuild Forest Camp in the style of Martin's fantastic descriptions.

videos.title: Night of the Moth
videos.overview: During an outdoor sleepover, Odo and Doodle encounter a moth who follows them.

videos.title: The Visitors
videos.overview: Camp is overrun by over-enthusiastic squirrels who can only say 'sorry' and 'thank you'.

videos.title: The Lost Voice
videos.overview: Doo the Canary loses her voice and can no longer sing with her sisters.

videos.title: The Favourite Mug
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle accidentally break Camp Leader's favourite mug.

videos.title: A Bat Called Boo
videos.overview: Odo is initially frightened when he meets Boo the Bat.

videos.title: The Big Rock
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle discover a huge Easter-Island-like statue that looks just like Camp.

videos.title: The Perfect Day
videos.overview: Odo tries to show Martin the perfect day, but everything Odo tries goes wrong.

videos.title: Wind Storm
videos.overview: While deep in the woods on a nature trek, the campers are caught in a windstorm.

videos.title: Holiday Blues
videos.overview: Pigeon Post seems glum. Odo and Doodle try to help Pigeon Post to be cheerful again.

videos.title: Flying Fox
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle teach Reggie the fox how to fly.

videos.title: To Bee or Not to Bee
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle miss out on a poetry slam so that they can nurse a tired bee.

videos.title: The Wedding
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle stage a wedding at camp.

videos.title: Stargazing
videos.overview: Inspector Feathers takes the campers out stargazing, but accidentally breaks her.

videos.title: The Bug Hotel
videos.overview: Odo and Doodle build a bug hotel for a bunch of homeless beetles.

videos.title: Odo's New Home
videos.overview: When his home suddenly creaks, lurches and slumps to one side, Odo goes on a search for a new house exactly like his old on.

videos.title: The Worry Box
videos.overview: The campers draw their worries and put them in a worry box . Odo is sure that if he can just get rid of the box, no one will ever have any worries.

videos.title: The Strawberry Sunset
videos.overview: The birds and the foxes get together on a hilltop for the fox's annual Strawberry Sunset Celebration.

videos.title: The Big Stink
videos.overview: A terrible stink descends on Forest Camp. It turns out to be Inspector Feathers's fertiliser.

videos.title: Hiccups
videos.overview: Camp is thrown into chaos by hiccupping squirrels.

videos.title: Imaginary Friends
videos.overview: Anna and Rudi fall out, so they create imaginary friends Adam and Roy to replace each other.

videos.title: Saving Pigeon Post
videos.overview: During a game of hide and seek, Doodle gets a funny feeling that Pigeon Post is in trouble. Together with the flamingos, they leave the game in order to rescue Pigeon Post.
